faq.question: Do I need to own land before contacting ALM?
faq.answer: No. You can contact ALM while you are still looking. The team can discuss potential lots or teardown properties, but a specific property still needs project-level review.

faq.question: Can ALM work with plans I already have?
faq.answer: Yes. If you already have architectural drawings, engineering, or conceptual plans, ALM can review them, assess site feasibility, and provide an accurate construction quote.

faq.question: What happens if there is an older home on the property?
faq.answer: ALM handles full teardown, site preparation, utility disconnections, and grading as part of the overall build agreement.

faq.question: How is the construction cost determined?
faq.answer: Pricing is based on your specific property conditions, selected architectural plans, finish levels, and approved engineering specifications—locked in before groundbreaking.

faq.question: Who handles permits and city inspections?
faq.answer: ALM manages all municipal filings, architectural submissions, structural reviews, inspections, and final occupancy certificate closeout.

faq.question: Can I change materials or finishes?
faq.answer: Yes. Any finish or scope adjustment is formally quoted, timeline-verified, and signed off in writing prior to execution on site.

faq.question: What is included in the finished home?
faq.answer: Every agreed interior and exterior finish—flooring, cabinetry, countertops, fixtures, appliances, mechanical connections, and paint—is fully resolved for move-in.

faq.question: Does ALM provide a builder warranty?
faq.answer: Yes. Every ALM custom home includes a comprehensive builder warranty package covering structural components, mechanical systems, and workmanship.
